name: relai-panel
description: RelAI panel for Claude Code (early access mods): a calm bar above the prompt with the active plan, stage and status, and a Tak/Nie row only while a decision card waits (the session's cost and the prompt-cache timer are relai-cache-keeper's); /relai-panel opens a pane with forms for the 14 RelAI commands, the project's cheat sheet, the session phrases, the session's measured costs (main loop, subagents, compactions; per agent, model and stage, priced at a dated list) and a map of the plans, their stages and branches and the /relai-crew runs, with the cost of each stage. Decisions go through a confirmation card in the pane: a stage starts from it in a fresh or the current chat with the person's consent, a crew is edited before its start, /relai-clean, /relai-update and /relai-models are prepared there; nothing is sent before "Tak". A documents tab shows the session-start layer of the project and marks each document the current turn changed. The price list carries its date and source, warns when it is old and names each model measured without a price; its one network request reads the Anthropic pricing page (platform.claude.com) only after "Tak" on a card, shows the old and new rates and writes .claude/relai/panel/cennik.json only after a second "Tak"; a cost already counted keeps the rates it was counted with. Measurements go to .claude/relai/pomiary/, a file per session, each tagged with the stage in progress and the crew task. Silent outside RelAI projects.
